25. Write notes on Acidic nature of ethyne

The polarity of the bond between H atom and triple bonded carbon atom can be explained on the basis of hybridization. In acetylene the carbon atoms are sp-hybridization and they possess 50% s-character and 50% p-character. So, the sp-hybridized carbon atom is more electronegative than hydrogen and the bonding pair of electrons are displaced towards the carbon atom and bearing partial negative charge and hydrogen atom bears partial positive charge. Due to this polarity generated, H- atoms are easily donated as their proton indicating the acidic property of acetylene.
The acidic nature of acetylene or ethyne is proved by the following reaction:
